_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

A Sandy Scandal#000.src: You look like a hardy one! {p} army, is it? Would you be willing to help {p} a bit?

A Sandy Scandal#001.src: We're looking into some witness reports to try to gain information on the bandits' plan.
A Sandy Scandal#001.dst: 강도들의 계획을 알아내려고 목격자 진술서 몇 건을 조사하고 있어요.

A Sandy Scandal#002.src: You read the report and visualize its words.
A Sandy Scandal#002.dst: 진술서를 읽자 그 장면이 눈앞에 그려진다.

A Sandy Scandal#003.src: WITNESS REPORT I - TOLD BY ODIN GIBBS, SHOP OWNER - GIBBS' MINING SUPPLY STORE CO.
A Sandy Scandal#003.dst: 목격자 진술서 I - 진술자: ODIN GIBBS, 가게 주인 - GIBBS' MINING SUPPLY STORE CO.

A Sandy Scandal#004.src: Business was slow that day, until two rugged, oddly-dressed men stormed into my shop, with a lot of nerve.
A Sandy Scandal#004.dst: 그날은 장사가 한산했다. 그런데 괴상한 차림의 험상궂은 사내 둘이 뻔뻔하게 가게로 들이닥쳤다.

A Sandy Scandal#005.src: Before I could close any deal with them, the man with a dagger started threatening me!
A Sandy Scandal#005.dst: 거래를 하기도 전에, 단검을 든 사내가 나를 협박하기 시작했다!

A Sandy Scandal#006.src: I tried to make peace with the crooks.
A Sandy Scandal#006.dst: 나는 그 악당들을 달래 보려 했다.

A Sandy Scandal#007.src: The bandit put the knife closer to me and started demanding the code to the TNT vault downstairs!
A Sandy Scandal#007.dst: 강도는 칼을 더 들이대며 지하 TNT 금고의 비밀번호를 내놓으라고 했다!

A Sandy Scandal#008.src: The bandits grew agitated and resorted to violence to obtain the combination.
A Sandy Scandal#008.dst: 강도들은 점점 초조해지더니 비밀번호를 얻으려고 폭력을 휘둘렀다.

A Sandy Scandal#009.src: They swiped their knife at me, leaving a sizeable wound on my arm.
A Sandy Scandal#009.dst: 그들이 칼을 휘둘러 내 팔에 꽤 큰 상처를 냈다.

A Sandy Scandal#010.src: I had no choice but to give up the combination, which was {~}.
A Sandy Scandal#010.dst: 어쩔 수 없이 비밀번호를 알려 줬다. 번호는 {~}.

A Sandy Scandal#011.src: After I gave up the combination, they knocked me out!
A Sandy Scandal#011.dst: 비밀번호를 알려 주자 그들은 나를 때려 기절시켰다!

A Sandy Scandal#012.src: I had no idea what the criminals did after that, I haven't been back to my shop since the incident.
A Sandy Scandal#012.dst: 그 뒤로 범인들이 무슨 짓을 했는지는 모른다. 그 일 이후로 가게에 돌아가지 않았다.

A Sandy Scandal#013.src: The bandits must've taken the explosives! You should investigate.
A Sandy Scandal#013.dst: 강도들이 폭약을 가져간 게 분명하다! 조사해 봐야겠다.

A Sandy Scandal#014.src: Looks like the bandit's took almost all of the TNT from the shopkeeper's vault.
A Sandy Scandal#014.dst: 강도들이 가게 주인의 금고에서 TNT를 거의 다 가져간 것 같다.

A Sandy Scandal#015.src: They seem to have dropped their knife during all the looting...

A Sandy Scandal#016.src: You should return to the {p} Bank Guard with your information.
A Sandy Scandal#016.dst: 알아낸 정보를 가지고 {p} 은행 경비병에게 돌아가야겠다.

A Sandy Scandal#017.src: WITNESS REPORT II - TOLD BY SCROLL MERCHANT, SHOP OWNER - ALMUJ SCROLL SHOP
A Sandy Scandal#017.dst: 목격자 진술서 II - 진술자: 두루마리 상인, 가게 주인 - ALMUJ SCROLL SHOP

A Sandy Scandal#018.src: I was having a fine time tending to my rooftop garden after a lengthy day of selling scrolls.
A Sandy Scandal#018.dst: 두루마리를 팔며 긴 하루를 보낸 뒤, 옥상 정원을 여유롭게 가꾸고 있었다.

A Sandy Scandal#019.src: While looking down on the street, I saw two unsavory men, one with TNT in hand, marching down the path.
A Sandy Scandal#019.dst: 길을 내려다보니 수상쩍은 사내 둘이 걸어가고 있었다. 한 명은 손에 TNT를 들고 있었다.

A Sandy Scandal#020.src: I was suspicious, so I tried to get their attention, but they ignored me.
A Sandy Scandal#020.dst: 수상해서 불러 세우려 했지만, 그들은 나를 무시했다.

A Sandy Scandal#021.src: I tried to yell for the attention of a guard or official, but nobody could hear me.
A Sandy Scandal#021.dst: 경비병이나 관리를 부르려고 소리쳤지만, 아무도 듣지 못했다.

A Sandy Scandal#022.src: I wasn't sure what to do at this point... I didn't try to confront them, that'd have been way too risky!
A Sandy Scandal#022.dst: 그때는 어떻게 해야 할지 몰랐다... 맞서지는 않았다. 그건 너무 위험했을 테니까!

A Sandy Scandal#023.src: I have no idea where they went off to afterwards.
A Sandy Scandal#023.dst: 그 뒤로 그들이 어디로 갔는지는 전혀 모른다.

A Sandy Scandal#024.src: You should check out the house that the explosion came from!

A Sandy Scandal#025.src: Two weapons are missing from the wealthy estate owner's weapon rack!
A Sandy Scandal#025.dst: 부유한 저택 주인의 무기 거치대에서 무기 두 개가 사라졌다!

A Sandy Scandal#026.src: With such powerful weapons the bandits could easily break through the bank's defenses.
A Sandy Scandal#026.dst: 저렇게 강력한 무기라면 강도들은 은행 방어선을 쉽게 뚫을 수 있다.

A Sandy Scandal#027.src: The whole thing'll go up in a few seconds, and any evidence will be buried in the sand. Good luck getting out of here!
A Sandy Scandal#027.dst: 몇 초 뒤면 여기가 전부 날아가고 증거는 모래에 묻힐 거다. 빠져나갈 수 있으면 해 봐라!

A Sandy Scandal#028.src: Looks like the bandit's have started their heist! You should follow them into the bank and stop them.
A Sandy Scandal#028.dst: 강도들이 은행 털이를 시작한 것 같다! 따라서 은행에 들어가 막아야 한다.

A Sandy Scandal#029.src: It's too late to stop us now! We're about to bust out of here with the grand prize - the contents of the emerald vault!
A Sandy Scandal#029.dst: 이제 와서 막기엔 너무 늦었어! 우린 곧 최고의 전리품 - 에메랄드 금고 안의 것들을 들고 튈 거다!

A Sandy Scandal#030.src: We think the bandits might have made the first move in their heist, we're mobilising a troop to-
A Sandy Scandal#030.dst: 강도들이 은행 털이의 첫 수를 둔 것 같아요. 부대를 동원해서-

A Sandy Scandal#031.src: Before anybody could hear me, a large explosion occurred inside of the house the bandits intruded.
A Sandy Scandal#031.dst: 누가 내 말을 듣기도 전에, 강도들이 침입한 집 안에서 큰 폭발이 일어났다.

A Sandy Scandal#032.src: Talk to the {p} Bank Guard at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

A Sandy Scandal#033.src: You look like a hardy one! {p} army is it? Would you be willing to help {p} a bit?
A Sandy Scandal#033.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#034.src: {p} bank tends to be a prime target for bandits, and there's been a string of incidents that have made us suspicious.
A Sandy Scandal#034.dst: {p} 은행은 강도들의 주요 표적이라서요. 의심스러운 사건이 연달아 일어났어요.
A Sandy Scandal#034.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#035.src: We're looking into some witness reports to try and gain information on the bandits' plan.
A Sandy Scandal#035.dst: 강도들의 계획을 알아내려고 목격자 진술서 몇 건을 조사하고 있어요.
A Sandy Scandal#035.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#036.src: If I give you some of the reports, will you help check them out for clues?
A Sandy Scandal#036.dst: 진술서를 좀 드리면 단서를 찾는 걸 도와줄래요?
A Sandy Scandal#036.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#037.src: Great! The store from the first witness report is straight down the stairs, just past this building right behind me.
A Sandy Scandal#037.dst: 좋아요! 첫 번째 진술서의 가게는 계단을 내려가 제 뒤 건물을 바로 지나면 있어요.
A Sandy Scandal#037.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#038.src: It's called "Gibbs' Mining Supply Store", and the owner reported a robbery a few days ago.
A Sandy Scandal#038.dst: 가게 이름은 "Gibbs' Mining Supply Store"인데, 며칠 전 주인이 강도 신고를 했어요.
A Sandy Scandal#038.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#039.src: Good luck! Report back to me if you find any information.
A Sandy Scandal#039.dst: 행운을 빌어요! 정보를 찾으면 보고해 주세요.
A Sandy Scandal#039.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#040.src: Go to the witness report location at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

A Sandy Scandal#041.src: Hello gentlemen! What can I interest you in today? Some industrial torches? Pickaxes?
A Sandy Scandal#041.dst: 어서 오세요, 손님들! 오늘은 뭘 보여 드릴까요? 산업용 횃불? 곡괭이?
A Sandy Scandal#041.speaker: Shopkeeper Gibbs

A Sandy Scandal#042.src: Shut yer’ trap, old man. We came for a different kind of business.
A Sandy Scandal#042.dst: 입 닥쳐, 영감. 우린 다른 볼일로 왔거든.
A Sandy Scandal#042.speaker: Bandit

A Sandy Scandal#043.src: Wha-? Look, fellows. Just step out of my store, and nobody gets hurt. I don't want any trouble.
A Sandy Scandal#043.dst: 뭐-? 이보시오, 젊은이들. 그냥 가게에서 나가면 아무도 안 다쳐. 난 말썽은 싫소.
A Sandy Scandal#043.speaker: Shopkeeper Gibbs

A Sandy Scandal#044.src: Listen up old man, tell us the code to the TNT vault in the basement, or I decorate my necklace with your fingers!
A Sandy Scandal#044.dst: 잘 들어, 영감. 지하 TNT 금고 비밀번호를 대. 안 그러면 네 손가락으로 목걸이를 꾸밀 거야!
A Sandy Scandal#044.speaker: Bandit

A Sandy Scandal#045.src: Certainly not! That TNT is for licensed mining companies only, not your average amateur miner.
A Sandy Scandal#045.dst: 절대 안 되오! 그 TNT는 허가받은 광산 회사 전용이지, 흔한 아마추어 광부용이 아니오.
A Sandy Scandal#045.speaker: Shopkeeper Gibbs

A Sandy Scandal#046.src: Well then! I guess you'll still be able to grasp a pick with four fingers, eh?
A Sandy Scandal#046.dst: 그래? 손가락 네 개로도 곡괭이는 쥘 수 있겠지, 응?
A Sandy Scandal#046.speaker: Bandit

A Sandy Scandal#047.src: Gaaah! Alright, alright! No more violence, please!
A Sandy Scandal#047.dst: 끄아악! 알았소, 알았소! 제발 그만 때리시오!
A Sandy Scandal#047.speaker: Shopkeeper Gibbs

A Sandy Scandal#048.src: The code is {~}-{~}-{~}-{~}... please don't hurt me!
A Sandy Scandal#048.speaker: Shopkeeper Gibbs

A Sandy Scandal#049.src: {~}-{~}-{~}-{~}... thanks! We won't be needing you anymore... now go to sleep!
A Sandy Scandal#049.speaker: Bandit

A Sandy Scandal#050.src: Open the vault in the basement [Code: {~}].

A Sandy Scandal#053.src: Talk to the {p} Bank Guard at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

A Sandy Scandal#054.src: Ah, you're back! Did you find anything interesting in the report?
A Sandy Scandal#054.dst: 아, 돌아왔군요! 진술서에서 뭔가 흥미로운 걸 찾았나요?
A Sandy Scandal#054.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#055.src: Missing TNT in the shop's vault? Looks like the shopkeeper was telling the truth.
A Sandy Scandal#055.dst: 가게 금고에서 TNT가 사라졌다고요? 가게 주인 말이 사실이었나 봐요.
A Sandy Scandal#055.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#056.src: We need to catch these criminals quickly if they have access to that amount of TNT - they could blow a hole right into the bank's vault!
A Sandy Scandal#056.dst: 그만한 TNT를 손에 넣었다면 빨리 잡아야 해요 - 은행 금고에 구멍을 뚫어 버릴 수도 있어요!
A Sandy Scandal#056.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#057.src: You should check out another witness report, from after the attack on the shopkeeper.
A Sandy Scandal#057.dst: 가게 주인이 습격당한 뒤에 나온 다른 진술서도 확인해 보세요.
A Sandy Scandal#057.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#058.src: It was taken from the rooftop garden of the Scroll Merchant's residence, you should take a look.
A Sandy Scandal#058.dst: 두루마리 상인 집 옥상 정원에서 받은 진술이에요. 한번 가 보세요.
A Sandy Scandal#058.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#059.src: Be quick! We don't have much time if we want to stop these bandits.
A Sandy Scandal#059.dst: 서둘러요! 강도들을 막으려면 시간이 얼마 없어요.
A Sandy Scandal#059.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#060.src: Go to the witness report location at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

A Sandy Scandal#062.src: Ey', what do you two blighters think you're doing with those dangerous explosives in the city?
A Sandy Scandal#062.dst: 이봐, 이 망할 놈들아, 그 위험한 폭약을 들고 도시에서 뭘 하는 거야?
A Sandy Scandal#062.speaker: Scroll Merchant

A Sandy Scandal#063.src: Guards! Guards! Robber! Come quick! Urgently!
A Sandy Scandal#063.dst: 경비병! 경비병! 강도야! 빨리 와요! 급해요!
A Sandy Scandal#063.speaker: Scroll Merchant

A Sandy Scandal#065.src: Find the source of the detonation at [{~}, {~}, {~}].

A Sandy Scandal#067.src: Talk to the {p} Bank Guard at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

A Sandy Scandal#068.src: Were you able to uncover any new information regarding the status of the criminals?
A Sandy Scandal#068.dst: 범인들의 행방에 대해 새로운 정보를 알아냈나요?
A Sandy Scandal#068.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#069.src: Ah... that's troubling. The criminals plundered two very powerful weapons.
A Sandy Scandal#069.dst: 아... 곤란하네요. 범인들이 아주 강력한 무기 두 개를 약탈했어요.
A Sandy Scandal#069.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#070.src: It won't be easy facing those criminals if they decide to raid the bank with those weapons.
A Sandy Scandal#070.dst: 그 무기를 들고 은행을 털러 온다면 상대하기 쉽지 않을 거예요.
A Sandy Scandal#070.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#071.src: I'm not certain how to proceed from here, we didn't receive any more witness reports, and-
A Sandy Scandal#071.dst: 이제 어떻게 해야 할지 모르겠어요. 진술서도 더 들어오지 않았고-
A Sandy Scandal#071.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#072.src: Boss, I just received urgent reports of a robbery underway in the left residential area of {p}!
A Sandy Scandal#072.dst: 대장님, 방금 {p} 왼쪽 주거 지역에서 강도 사건이 벌어지고 있다는 긴급 보고가 들어왔습니다!
A Sandy Scandal#072.speaker: Almuj Sentry

A Sandy Scandal#073.src: Oh my… you! Soldier! Quick! The robbery is taking place across the bridge, next to the first house you visited today! It may be the bandits we're looking for.
A Sandy Scandal#073.dst: 이런… 당신! 병사! 서둘러요! 강도는 다리 건너, 오늘 처음 갔던 집 옆에서 벌어지고 있어요! 우리가 쫓는 강도들일지도 몰라요.
A Sandy Scandal#073.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#074.src: There will be somebody waiting for you outside of the house once you get to the residential area!
A Sandy Scandal#074.dst: 주거 지역에 도착하면 집 밖에서 누군가 기다리고 있을 거예요!
A Sandy Scandal#074.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#075.src: If you still can't find it, I've written the coordinates in your content book. Now quickly, get to the house!
A Sandy Scandal#075.dst: 그래도 못 찾으면 콘텐츠 북에 좌표를 적어 뒀어요. 자, 어서 집으로 가요!
A Sandy Scandal#075.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#076.src: Quickly! Go to the house at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

A Sandy Scandal#077.src: Hello? Are you with the guards? Good! Hurry! Some bandits just ransacked my house, and left with lots of emeralds!
A Sandy Scandal#077.dst: 여보세요? 경비대에서 왔어요? 다행이다! 서둘러요! 강도들이 우리 집을 털고 에메랄드를 잔뜩 가져갔어요!
A Sandy Scandal#077.speaker: Almuj Citizen

A Sandy Scandal#078.src: Follow me to my house, hopefully you can find the bandits! They stole lots of my precious gems!
A Sandy Scandal#078.dst: 우리 집으로 따라와요, 강도들을 찾을 수 있으면 좋겠어요! 내 귀한 보석을 잔뜩 훔쳐 갔어요!
A Sandy Scandal#078.speaker: Almuj Citizen

A Sandy Scandal#079.src: Look for signs of the bandits' whereabouts.
A Sandy Scandal#079.dst: 강도들의 행방을 알려 줄 흔적을 찾으세요.

A Sandy Scandal#081.src: Ready, boys? We've got the TNT, weapons, and the fastest horses those emeralds could buy. Now we just-
A Sandy Scandal#081.dst: 준비됐냐, 얘들아? TNT, 무기, 그리고 에메랄드로 살 수 있는 가장 빠른 말까지 챙겼다. 이제 우린-
A Sandy Scandal#081.speaker: Bandit Leader

A Sandy Scandal#082.src: Ahah. I had a feeling we had a guard on our tail.
A Sandy Scandal#082.dst: 하하. 경비병이 꼬리를 밟은 것 같더라니.
A Sandy Scandal#082.speaker: Bandit Leader

A Sandy Scandal#083.src: No point wasting these brand-new weapons on you... since we're blowing up this hideout anyway!
A Sandy Scandal#083.dst: 새 무기를 너한테 낭비할 필요 없지... 어차피 이 은신처는 날려 버릴 거니까!
A Sandy Scandal#083.speaker: Bandit Leader

A Sandy Scandal#084.src: This whole thing'll go up in a few seconds, and any evidence will be buried in the sand. Good luck getting out of here!
A Sandy Scandal#084.dst: 몇 초 뒤면 여기가 전부 날아가고 증거는 모래에 묻힐 거다. 빠져나갈 수 있으면 해 봐라!
A Sandy Scandal#084.speaker: Bandit Leader

A Sandy Scandal#086.src: Find where the bandits blasted a hole to get into the bank at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
A Sandy Scandal#086.dst: [{~}, {~}, -{~}]에서 강도들이 은행에 들어가려고 폭파한 구멍을 찾으세요.

A Sandy Scandal#087.src: It’s too late to stop us now! We’re already about to bust out of here with the grand prize - the contents of the emerald vault!
A Sandy Scandal#087.dst: 이제 와서 막기엔 너무 늦었어! 우린 곧 최고의 전리품 - 에메랄드 금고 안의 것들을 들고 튈 거다!
A Sandy Scandal#087.speaker: Bandit Leader

A Sandy Scandal#088.src: Follow the criminals into the other room.

A Sandy Scandal#089.src: Look here, the soldier decided they wanted to follow us. Dumb move.
A Sandy Scandal#089.dst: 이것 봐라, 병사 나리가 따라오기로 했나 보군. 멍청한 짓이지.
A Sandy Scandal#089.speaker: Bandit Leader

A Sandy Scandal#090.src: I guess we can kill two birds with one stone: escaping the bank, and killing this pest.
A Sandy Scandal#090.dst: 일석이조로 가자고. 은행에서 탈출하고, 이 해충도 죽이고.
A Sandy Scandal#090.speaker: Bandit Leader

A Sandy Scandal#093.src: Report back to the {p} Bank Guard at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

A Sandy Scandal#094.src: Soldier! Where did you disappear to? Did you hear those explosions, below the bank?
A Sandy Scandal#094.dst: 병사! 어디 갔었어요? 은행 아래에서 폭발 소리 들었어요?
A Sandy Scandal#094.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#095.src: We think those bandits might have made their first move in the heist, we're mobilising a troop to-

A Sandy Scandal#096.src: You've already stopped them? And reclaimed the stolen weapons and explosives..?
A Sandy Scandal#096.dst: 벌써 막았다고요? 도둑맞은 무기와 폭약까지 되찾았고요..?

A Sandy Scandal#097.src: Wow. Excellent work, soldier. {p} is in your debt. Please accept these from our vault, as a token of our thanks.
A Sandy Scandal#097.dst: 와. 훌륭해요, 병사. {p}은(는) 당신에게 빚을 졌어요. 감사의 표시로 금고에서 꺼낸 이것들을 받아 주세요.
A Sandy Scandal#097.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#098.src: I then realized that they had no innocent itinerary, they were heading straight for my wealthy neighbor's house!
A Sandy Scandal#098.dst: 그제야 깨달았죠. 그들은 그냥 지나가던 게 아니라, 부자인 우리 이웃집으로 곧장 향하고 있었어요!

A Sandy Scandal#099.src: The bandits came sprinting out of my wealthy neighbor's house with some of his most prized possessions: two weapons from his collection.
A Sandy Scandal#099.dst: 강도들이 부자 이웃집에서 그의 가장 귀한 소장품, 수집품 중 무기 두 자루를 들고 뛰쳐나왔어요.
